notes.title: Game moving forward
A small note and warning.
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Dropping by to provide some information and updates.

The demo is expected to be released between December and January.

The demo will include at least half of the first chapter, up to the first mini-boss. While not all features and functionalities of the game will be present, a significant portion of the main mechanics will be showcased.

Additionally, a small note and warning:

Be aware that someone is engaging in malicious activities by PRETENDING to share unreleased indie games on platforms like Discord, etc.

We have never provided any demos, betas, links, or files for downloading.

Do not trust any messages or similar content!

Please rely only on official information available on the Steam page—our sole source for release updates.

Thank you!
